proof.criterion: Round 5 item 2: a graceful stop whose release call runs past its bound still writes its release
proof.surface: pod-a behind a relay with separate bus and lease gates, a prompt in hand; at SIGTERM the bus link froze (flush and drain at their bounds) and the lease link froze 3.6-7.2 s after it

The implementer's unit test is its fail-before.
